name: StrengthConditioningProgramBuilder
tagline: Periodised strength programs with %1RM loads, athlete assignment, session logging and progression – one drop-in Power Apps control.
description: A complete S&C programming app for clubs, academies, universities and gyms: build blocks, weeks and sessions with sets, reps and %1RM, see calculated loads rounded to your plates, copy weeks with progression, assign weeks to athletes, log sessions on a phone and let rules flag capacity problems, weekly load spikes and lifts that are ready to progress.
features: Demo mode with a fictional 7-athlete, 6-week pre-season program (504 lines)
Epley capacity check with RPE (reps in reserve)
Copy week → next week with progression step
Ready-to-progress detection and Progress later weeks
Weekly tonnage chart and load-spike flags
Quick filters, filter drawer, sort and group
Phone layout with bottom view bar and week stepper
